SparseTrack.named_mechanism: SparseTrack - Pseudo-depth based sparse subset decomposition with hierarchical association

pseudo_depth_estimation.definition: Estimate relative depth from 2D bounding box using vertical position and area
assumptions: Objects lower in image are closer to camera
Larger objects are closer to camera
pseudo_depth_estimation.fidelity_notes: Uses weighted combination of normalized y-position and inverse area

sparse_subset_decomposition.definition: Partition detections into L depth layers based on pseudo-depth values
sparse_subset_decomposition.fidelity_notes: Uses L=4 layers with equal-sized partitions

hierarchical_association.definition: Associate tracklets and detections layer-by-layer from closest to farthest
assumptions: Closer objects should be matched first
Unmatched tracklets can be passed to deeper layers
hierarchical_association.fidelity_notes: Greedy matching with IoU threshold, unmatched tracks propagate to next layer

invariants: Each detection belongs to exactly one depth layer
Layer processing order: closest (layer 0) to farthest (layer L-1)
Low-score detection matching occurs after all layer processing
deviations_from_ideal: Uses greedy matching instead of full Hungarian algorithm
Pseudo-depth is heuristic rather than true depth measurement
No explicit occlusion reasoning beyond low-score detection handling

ByteTrack.named_mechanism: ByteTrack - Two-stage association using all detection boxes

detection_partitioning.definition: Split detections into high-score (>=threshold) and low-score (<threshold) groups
assumptions: Low-score may contain occluded true objects
detection_partitioning.fidelity_notes: Uses threshold=0.5 as in original paper

first_stage_association.definition: Match high-score detections with all active tracklets using motion similarity
assumptions: IoU is sufficient for short-term association
first_stage_association.fidelity_notes: Uses IoU threshold=0.3 for valid matches

second_stage_association.definition: Match unmatched tracklets from stage 1 with low-score detections
assumptions: Occluded objects have lower detection scores but maintain motion continuity
second_stage_association.fidelity_notes: Uses more lenient IoU threshold=0.5 for low-score matching

conservative_track_creation.definition: Only create new tracks from unmatched high-score detections
assumptions: Low-score detections alone are insufficient evidence for new objects

invariants: Stage 1 must complete before Stage 2 begins
New tracks only created from high-score detections
Low-score detections never initialize new tracks
deviations_from_ideal: No appearance features (Re-ID) as in some ByteTrack variants
Simplified Kalman filter compared to BoT-SORT extensions
